generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per tender document.
Rates quoted should be exclusive of GST.

As a proof of this, the bidder shall upload work done/ work completion certificate issued by the competent authority along with the technical bid.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Comprehensive Maintenance of centralized HVAC System through Annual maintenance contract for a Period of One year extendable to another year, at KPCL new office complex, Drugs Controllers office premises, Palace Road, Bengaluru

itemList.description:
Comprehensive Maintenance of Centralized HVAC System through Annual maintenance contract at KPCL Green building, Bengaluru for a Period of One year which cover the operation & maintenance of all the HVAC equipment’s as described in the scope of the work, servicing of equipment/systems, attending to regular inspection/preventive maintenance, quarterly preventive maintenance & corrective/replacement works on occurrences of breakdown.
All the spares shall be included in the costing of Comprehensive CAMC.
